hi.title: H.A.R.S.H.A
hi.decryption: Remember these 5 pillars to describe the artistic milieu of Harsha's reign.

fact.en: Do not confuse Harsha's art with the Gupta 'Golden Age' style; Harsha's period shows signs of decline in stone sculpture quality.
fact.hi: Do not confuse Harsha's art with the Gupta 'Golden Age' style; Harsha's period shows signs of decline in stone sculpture quality.

fact.en: Remember that Harsha was not a grand builder of new temple complexes; he is better known for patronage of Buddhist Viharas.
fact.hi: Remember that Harsha was not a grand builder of new temple complexes; he is better known for patronage of Buddhist Viharas.
